name: Hidden Princess
author: Addicting Games
description: Hidden Princess is a puzzle game based on fairytale images. A beautiful princess is frolicking through the forest with creatures, filled with curiosity, animals circle around her. In this magical forest, there are hidden objects that you must find in order to solve the level. There are 3 levels in total and they each have their own challenges. Find crowns, swords, bows, and flowers in this forest to win the game. Some objects are big and obvious while others are small or blend in well. Take advantage of the zoom feature to search every corner. This game is not timed but you do have a limit on turns. With every completed list, you gained more turns. If you run out of turns, you lose the level and have to start over.
